model_year.note: Label for the year whose specs are quoted. Not a statement about availability.

length_in.note: Secondary source: C/D 2027 Equinox EV RS. Chevrolet's 2027 Equinox EV page has no dimensions in text; the Chevrolet newsroom is client-rendered. Same figure on C/D's 2026 page.

awd.label: LT, RS
awd.note: Chevrolet 2027 page: '307 miles of range on available AWD models'. Trim list is from the page's savings calculator, which lists 2026 models (RS AWD, LT1 AWD, RS FWD, LT1 FWD); 2027 AWD trims not itemized.

charge_port.note: 2027 page: 'the new standard NACS charging port expands access to more charging stations'. 'New' implies earlier model years had a different port; applies to 2027.

supercharger_access.note: 2027 Equinox EV page: 'the new standard NACS charging port expands access to more charging stations'. Chevrolet's EV hub (https://www.chevrolet.com/electric): 'more DC fast chargers — including Tesla Superchargers — that are compatible with the standard NACS charge ports.'

cross_check.note: Tesla lists General Motors (GM) among manufacturers with access to NACS Superchargers; 'For new vehicles that are NACS-equipped, no adapter will be necessary.' Read through headless Edge (sources/tesla-supercharging-other-evs-rendered.html); curl gets HTTP 403.

us_status.note: Chevrolet page titled '2027 Equinox EV' with starting price; Chevrolet's EV hub links 2026 Equinox EV configurator and inventory.

epa_range.note: EPA lists a single 2027 Equinox EV, the AWD. The 2026 FWD listing (49953) was 319 mi.

cargo_cu_ft.note: C/D 2026 LT1 w/PCY 4dr, cargo space behind the second row and behind the front row.

turning_circle_ft.note: C/D 2026 LT1 w/PCY 4dr, 'Turning Diameter / Radius, curb to curb (feet)'.
